name: Crawler
observations: A crafting-focused vampire-survivors-like game set in a brutal intergalactic reality-show dungeon narrated by an AI showrunner called The Director
Tech stack: TypeScript (strict), Phaser 4, bitecs 0.4, Vite, Vitest, fast-check
Entirely agent-driven project; all gameplay logic is deterministic
Repo: nalfeo/Crawler; default branch main

name: Determinism_Rule
observations: All game randomness MUST use SeededRandom from src/shared/random.ts; never Math.random()
Never use Date.now() in game logic; pass delta or frameCount as parameters
CI gates are deterministic scripts with exit codes; no LLM-as-judge in CI

name: SeededRandom
observations: Deterministic RNG used for ALL game randomness
Defined in src/shared/random.ts
Required by the determinism rule in place of Math.random()

name: Layer_Boundaries
observations: Five layers with strict one-way imports enforced by ESLint: core, engine, game, labs, shared
src/core must not import from engine, game, or labs
src/engine must not import from game or labs
src/game must not import from engine or labs
src/labs is unrestricted
Additional non-layer dirs exist: src/bootstrap and src/devtools

name: src_core
observations: Pure ECS game logic; no rendering imports
Must not import Phaser
Systems are usually shaped as (world: GameWorld) => void and are deterministic

name: src_engine
observations: Phaser 4 bridge; rendering only
Replaceable layer kept separate from logic via the bridge pattern

name: src_game
observations: Game systems: crafting, loot, floors, AI, combat, progression
Must not import from engine or labs

name: src_labs
observations: Dev sandboxes; unrestricted imports
Every new ECS system MUST have a lab here before it ships
Labs are registered in src/lab-main.ts and run via npm run lab

name: src_shared
observations: Constants, types, pure utilities
Contains src/shared/random.ts (SeededRandom) and src/shared/constants.ts
Tunable values load from src/shared/data/tuning.json

name: Phaser_Bridge_Pattern
observations: No Phaser imports allowed in src/core to keep logic portable
Rendering lives only in src/engine; the bridge scales feet to pixels at draw time

name: ECS_bitecs
observations: Game logic uses bitecs 0.4 ECS
Systems are deterministic, usually (world: GameWorld) => void
Established in ADR 0001

name: Lab_Gating_Rule
observations: No ECS system ships without a lab in src/labs
Enforced in CI via scripts/agent/lab-gate-check.sh
Established in ADR 0002

name: Conventional_Commits
observations: Commit messages enforced by commitlint
Allowed types: feat, fix, chore, docs, lab, refactor, test, perf, ci, build, revert

name: Verification_Commands
observations: npm run verify:fast runs typecheck + lint + unit tests (about 30s) after every change
npm run verify runs the full suite before committing (about 3min): typecheck + lint + format + dead-code (knip) + unit tests with coverage + integration + headless Floor 1 gate + vite build
Lab-gate is a separate check (scripts/agent/lab-gate-check.sh), not part of verify:fast or verify
Test projects: unit, integration, headless, e2e via vitest
Use createTestWorld from tests/helpers/world-factory.ts; never construct worlds manually

name: Memory_Policy
observations: Three-tier memory: hot (always-loaded rules), codified (personas/policies/guides/ADRs), on-demand (handoffs/notes)
Defined in docs/agent-os/policies/memory-policy.md
Principle: nothing is deleted, only archived

name: Handoff_Protocol
observations: Every session writes a handoff before ending: docs/knowledge/handoffs/YYYY-MM-DD-slug.md
Minimum contents: summary, files touched, verification run, unresolved issues, next steps
Part of the Memory Policy

name: Apple_Complexity
observations: Declare a complexity estimate of 1 to 5 apples before writing any code
Score actuals and a verdict at handoff
Record in docs/knowledge/metrics/apples/YYYY-MM-DD-slug.json
Defined in docs/agent-os/policies/complexity-policy.md

name: Merge_Policy
observations: Authorized merges use: gh pr merge --auto --squash
No human review is required to merge; branch protection does not require an approving review
Diagnose real CI failures before giving up; never blame a human review block without explicit proof

name: Spatial_Units_Feet
observations: Feet is the single internal spatial unit everywhere except rendering
PIXELS_PER_FOOT = 8; default arena is 160x90 ft, mirroring the 1280x720 px canvas
Render canvas is 1280x720 at 60 FPS fixed timestep (GAME.DELTA_MS = 1000/60)
Established in ADR 0023 (feet-as-single-internal-spatial-unit)

name: createTestWorld
observations: Factory for constructing ECS worlds in tests
Located at tests/helpers/world-factory.ts
Always use it; never construct worlds manually

name: ADR_0001_ECS_Architecture
observations: Establishes the bitecs ECS architecture
File: docs/knowledge/adr/0001-ecs-architecture.md
Status: accepted

name: ADR_0002_Lab_Gated_Development
observations: Every system must have a lab before shipping; enforced in CI
File: docs/knowledge/adr/0002-lab-gated-development.md
Status: accepted

name: ADR_0023_Feet_Spatial_Unit
observations: Adopts feet as the single internal spatial unit; bridge converts to pixels at render time
File: docs/knowledge/adr/0023-feet-as-single-internal-spatial-unit.md
Status: accepted

name: Combat_System
observations: Damage, health, knockback, and melee/ranged/projectile/beam weapons
Lives in src/game; lab: weapon-lab (covers combat + all weapon types)
WeaponType enum (src/shared/constants.ts): MELEE, RANGED, MAGIC, THROWN, BEAM, TRAP

name: Drops_Loot_System
observations: Loot drops and pickups
Lives in src/game; lab: drop-lab
Architecture in ADR 0006 (drops-system-architecture)

name: AI_Behavior_Tree
observations: Enemy AI via behavior trees with pure, deterministic decision kernels
Lives in src/game/ai; pure kernels in src/game/ai/exploration.ts
src/game/ai is reserved for future Ollama integration, floor-load only; see ADR 0022

name: Floor_System
observations: Procedural floor generation, rooms, doors, and special-room sealing
Lives in src/game; labs include ai-runner, map-gen-lab, door-lab
Floor 1 has a headless victory completion gate in tests

name: Sprite_Pipeline
observations: Multi-stage sprite generation and judging workflow under scripts/sprites
Commands: npm run sprites:* (run, gallery, approve, synth, batch, asset-plan, sync-catalog, metadata)
Architecture in ADR 0003 (sprite-generation-pipeline)

name: Agent_Memory_Store
observations: This knowledge graph persists durable facts for AI coding agents across sessions
Backed by docs/knowledge/agent-memory.jsonl and served by the MCP memory server, launched via the portable wrapper scripts/agent/mcp-memory-server.mjs
The wrapper resolves a per-user live file (under ~/.copilot/crawler-memory), seeds it from the snapshot, and sets MEMORY_FILE_PATH; .mcp.json holds no machine-specific path
At session start, call read_graph or search_nodes; record durable facts as entities, observations, and relations
Complements the file-based three-tier Memory Policy; setup and sync are documented in docs/guides/agent-memory.md
